title: feat: add NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Adds `nemotron` with three versioned aliases and the existing NVIDIA brand.
- Routes directly to DeepInfra's exact standard-tier checkpoint with no fallback.
- Registers text/tool/reasoning capabilities, 262,144 context, paid-only access, and exact `$0.50/$0.10/$2.20` per-million input/cache/output rates.
- Normalizes DeepInfra's incorrect `stop` finish reason to `length` when the configured token limit is reached.

| Provider | Input | Output | Paid-only | Multiplier | Pollinations GPU | Fallback |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| DeepInfra direct | text | text | yes | 1 | no | none |

## Verification

- Direct and authenticated local E2E: canonical model, all aliases, streaming, tools, reasoning, structured JSON, paid-only gating, malformed and oversized requests, cache behavior, and token-limit handling.
- Usage headers, provider tokens, ledger deductions, and registry pricing reconcile exactly; 50/50 burst requests passed with no 429 or 5xx.
- Gen: 724/724 tests, typecheck, and Vite production build.
- Enter: 301/301 alias and pricing tests.

DeepInfra posts cached-input pricing, but repeated probes did not produce a provider cache hit. Row-level staging Tinybird verification was unavailable because no staging read credential is configured; local tracking logs verified exact billing.

gist.headline: Nemotron joins the garden
gist.blurb: A new NVIDIA brain has landed in the hive. Nemotron 3 Ultra brings a very large context window, tools, reasoning, and a direct route to DeepInfra—no mystery detours through the hedges.
gist.summary: Added NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra as `nemotron` plus three versioned aliases, routed directly to DeepInfra’s standard-tier checkpoint with text, tool use, reasoning, structured JSON, a 262,144-token context window, and paid-only pricing of $0.50/$0.10/$2.20 per million input/cached-input/output tokens.
gist.impact: Developers can call Nemotron 3 Ultra through the existing text API for long-context, tool-enabled, and reasoning workloads, with exact usage billing and token-limit responses normalized from DeepInfra’s `stop` to `length` when the configured limit is reached.
